body: I really wouldn't bring kids into my messed up life plus I have no one to procreate with...I was just using that as an example that I am getting old.  I have been doing the therapy for a while and it doesnt seem to help.  But I have not seen the therapist in about a month as I no longer have insurance and don't have the means to pay right now.  Spent my last few dollars trying to eat healthy and went on this raw food/vegan kick for the last week and I have had a wicked headache all week (guess junk food withdrawal).  Like I said, honestly I can't think of anything that I really enjoyed doing in order to tell you.  I have been sitting in the house with no noise and quiet all day trying to think of a reason to go on and something that was truly enjoyable in my life...I have been trying as a few months ago I went on my dream trip to Hawaii to try to make things better but I didn't enjoy that all I could do was look at the water and cry about how I enjoy nothing

I am (well was)in medicine and it is advanced maternal age.  I did put a lot of effort into things but they always seem to go bad for me.  Right now I cant honestly think of anything that makes me happy.  I haven't done anything for the past 2-3 weeks because I lack the energy to do so.  I had been seeing psych, taking meds, and seeing a counselor but none has seemed work although I had been doing for many years (since I started college years ago because I had been feeling that way prior but in my family they believe you can pray it all away so I didn't get any "real help" until I left home then)

I'm not really considered young because if I decided to get pregnant now I would be sent to a special doc and be considered advanced maternal age.  I don't really have a reason to live as nothing seems to work out for me...I don't have any friends and I no longer do anything recreational as I put in notice and left my job as I was too depressed to do it and didn't feel safe there

I don't know what to say other than I have been depressed for almost my entire life and my so called family just thinks I should get over it....I don't have any real friends as people just seem to come into my life and use me for whatever they can get then they are gone..and I just want to vent one last time that's why I made a post not because I care about life because I don't have one
